source.surface: Compare changes modal, main component against current version, one removed layer selected
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControl: no accept or apply control is present on this surface
decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: not applicable — the modal is read-only comparison, so there is no decision affordance to colour
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: not applicable; the only exit is a close glyph at the top right
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: red and green are used exclusively as change semantics (Removed / Added) and never as disposition semantics
decisionColour.verdict: A review surface with no decision on it. Because nothing here can be accepted, red and green are free to mean removed and added without colliding with a disposition, which is the cleanest way to avoid the two-meanings-of-one-hue problem: separate the reading surface from the deciding surface.

facts.subject: layer-list
facts.value: all Added rows are grouped above all Removed rows rather than interleaved in canvas order

facts.subject: comparison-panes
facts.locatorDescription: the dashed rectangles in the "Main component" pane are red; the dashed rectangles in the "Current version" pane are blue

facts.subject: changed-element-marking
facts.value: a dashed outline drawn around the element in place, leaving the element itself rendered normally underneath
facts.locatorDescription: "Main component" pane, the dashed rectangles around the logo mark, the wordmark "ASMobbin", the star, and the line drawing

facts.subject: selected-layer
facts.value: a full-width tinted banner at the top of the property panel stating the change in a sentence
facts.locatorDescription: right panel, the pale red banner reading "This layer was removed"

facts.subject: changed-properties
facts.value: the individual property lines are printed as code and given the same red tint as the banner, so the reason is shown at property granularity rather than summarised

facts.subject: property-panel

facts.subject: comparison-view
facts.locatorDescription: bottom left of the comparison area, the segmented control reading "Side by side" and "Overlay"

facts.subject: comparison-panes

facts.locatorDescription: bottom right of the "Current version" pane, reading "− Fit +"

facts.subject: pane-headers
